x: One half of our Editorial team, namely Alan Mead, found this fact most interesting, for in the late 'fifties, as a fourteen year old looking for a club to join himself, he was encouraged to give Belgrave a try by one of his school-friends - Douglas Gordon, son of Bert.
All four decided to join Belgrave; Doug Gordon dropping out fairly soon but Dave Cocks going on to be a Surrey County 880 yards Champion with a sub 1:50 performance.
Not only did we know about them, of course, but it transpired that our enquirer was still in touch with one of his relations - Douglas Gordon.
